capabilities: Restore or permanently delete notes from a local bin
Navigate vault folders via a simplified tree
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page that combines quick file-name lookup, recent-note access, and restoring deleted notes in one place.
summary: Home-screen view that provides file-name search, recent and pinned notes, deleted-note restore, and vault folder navigation.
